core_memory.diabetes_treatment: Type 2 Diabetes: Currently on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Doctor suggested adding semaglutide(Ozempic) at a low dose to improve blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically ranges between 125-130 mg/dL.
core_memory.hypertension_treatment: High Blood Pressure: Currently on losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure readings typically range from 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reducing sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
core_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily. Taken on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH test result: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). No dosage changes needed. Noticeable sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.
core_memory.osteoarthritis_treatment: Osteoarthritis: Uses acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Takes meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints(knees and hands) are particularly stiff or painful. Avoids daily use of NSAIDs to prevent overuse. Doctor recommended glucosamine supplements; effect on symptoms is uncertain and not yet confirmed.
core_memory.cholesterol_treatment: Statin therapy: Taking atorvastatin 10 mg daily. Initial LDL: 130 mg/dL, triglycerides: 140 mg/dL. Doctor prescribed low-dose statin to improve lipid profile. Cholesterol levels have improved, and no side effects(like muscle aches) reported so far.
core_memory.medication_interactions_precautions: NSAIDs(e.g., meloxicam) limit use due to kidney risks. Take levothyroxine on empty stomach, 30 min before meals, separate from calcium/iron to avoid absorption issues.
core_memory.overall_health_goals: Medication routine is working well. Stays organized with a pill planner and phone reminders. Focuses on lifestyle changes to reduce reliance on medications. Goal: Maintain optimal health and avoid unnecessary prescriptions by managing conditions naturally when possible.
